newsitem.title: GERMANY: BME/Reuters German purchasing managers index rises.
newsitem.headline: BME/Reuters German purchasing managers index rises.

text.p: A new index based on purchasing managers' perceptions of the German economy showed growth in the manufacturing sector is gathering pace, while employment remains in decline.

The BME/Reuters German Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) rose to 56.58 in April on a seasonally-adjusted basis from 54.58 in March, reaching its highest level since the survey it is based on was started in April 1996.
On an unadjusted basis, the PMI, launched on Tuesday, rose to 57.93 in April from 56.43.
The index is based on a survey of 350 companies carried out exclusively for Reuters by research group NTC Publications Ltd.
